summary: Game crashes when a wind charge hits an entity after disabling update_1_21 data pack
description: The game crashes when hit by a breeze after disabling the update_1_21 data pack. Steps to reproduce - Create a new world with update_1_21 data pack enabled. - Run /datapack disable update_1_21 and exit the world. - Rejoin the world, spawn a breeze and go into survival mode. - Wait for the breeze to attack you and the game will crash instantly. I filed this bug report following a discussion on the Minecraft Commands Discord server involving , using s repro steps.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Create a new world with the update_1_21 data pack enabled.
2. Run the command `/datapack disable update_1_21` and exit the world.
3. Rejoin the world.
4. Spawn a breeze using the appropriate item or command.
5. Switch to Survival mode.
6. Wait for the breeze to attack you.
7. Observe that the game crashes instantly when hit by the breeze.
Observed Behavior: The game crashes when hit by a breeze after disabling the update_1_21 data pack. To reproduce this issue, first create a new world with the update_1_21 data pack enabled. Next, run the command `/datapack disable update_1_21` and exit the world. Upon rejoining the world, spawn a breeze and switch to survival mode. As soon as the breeze attacks you, the game will crash instantly. This bug was identified following a discussion on the Minecraft Commands Discord server using specified reproduction steps.
Expected Behavior: When the update_1_21 data pack is disabled and re-enabled in a world, the game should not crash when a breeze attacks an entity. Instead, the breeze should behave normally, attacking entities without causing any instability or crashes. The player should be able to continue playing in survival mode without encountering any issues related to the breeze mechanic.
